test_title: PYST 51: SSC MTS 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 16 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'RUDE' is written as 'EDUR48'. How will 'SOUP' be written in that language?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7fd46426f00ba56b91d423458faa673503496b14e50413ec14eae6a6e84c211.png] The logic followed here is :- Alphabets are interchanged from left to right to right to left and sum of alphabetical positional value given. 'RUDE' is written as 'EDURA48'.
